About Shimshon Advisory Private Limited

Shimshon Advisory Private Limited, a active private limited company, was established on 21 October 2020 in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India. Engaging in business & it consulting within the professional, scientific and technical sector, it holds CIN: U74110MH2020PTC348401. Registered under ROC Roc Mumbai. it is unlisted. It has an authorized capital of ₹4.00 Cr and a paid-up capital of ₹3.01 Cr.

Formerly known as Shimshon Finance Private Limited. Its leadership includes Anurag Singh(Director), Kunal Gopal Tekwani(Director). Past directors included Anurag Singh, Kunal Gopal Tekwani, Paresh Manubhai Shah. It holds ₹33.90 Cr open charges and no settled loans. Its latest AGM occurred on 30 September 2025, with the balance sheet filed on 31 March 2025. It is based at 601, Gayatri Chs Ltd. Jayraj Nagar, Vazira Naka, Borivali West, Mumbai, Maharashtra, 400092.
